Past continuous · 高频真题: The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为高频真题练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。
was + V-ing (I/he/she/it)|were + V-ing (you/we/they)|often with at that time, at eight last night|the negative is was/were not + V-ing|the question moves was/were before the subject
I was reading at nine last night.
I was reading at nine last night.|I was read at nine last night.|I were reading at nine last night.|I read at nine last night.
column4: was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:I was reading at nine last night.
